reviews.review:
YES
(reminder this is a sandbox game, not a large scale tactical battlefield) 
-edit
for starters i wanna say i really love this game, i can safely say as a former console player who once long dreamed to get my hands on the iconic Arma franchise. after many years of considering getting into PC gaming i finally purchased a PC for the sole reason to play arma 3. this game will have you soaked for hours on end, sure it can sometime be a running simulator depending on how you play and your attitude as to whether you wanna actually wanna win or just go for kills. if you think you can play this game all trigger happy then you belong in the battlefield or call of duty era of games. this game if for the patient and strategic players. experience realism and amazing scale of tactical shooters. im gonna divide this game into 3 categories: 
1.multiplayer
2.cons
3. mods


so in terms of multiplayer with other people i wish you luck in finding a base game server to join, no that its terrible its actually really fun. The game is pretty old so your only way to really play with people is probably modded servers which most of them are locked behind passwords or will ask you to join their milsim. im personally not into that sort of group, although i have played that playstyle in games, its not for me (due to an incident ruining my image of milsim players). i always imagine them as being honorable and cool people but most are edgy 17 year old kids who think they are bigger and badder than anyone simply because they throw some military slang and abusing their leadership. not to say that milsims are not good groups and communities, but there is a line that no one should cross regardless if you are veteran or not. There is a line that separates fun tactical play and the far stretch of unnecessary ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ committed by milsim groups. Throwing threats, accusing and blacklisting members for ♥♥♥♥♥♥ reasons is why I dislike majority of milsims and those who try way too hard to impersonate something they know little about. Enough of that talk and more about how the game really is. In short, I don’t recommend this game for multiplayer unless you have some friends to play co-op with and create your own missions is exactly what majority of my time on this game is. After watching some videos and learning through trial and error I learned how to create some tier 1 missions and even a few major operations meant for 4-6 people.  I am not a fan of defensive, let's stay here for 3 hours playing role play operations. I'm more into let's execute a plan and push enemy territory. If you like that playstyle I recommend doing operations or missions similar to how operator drewski does his. The editor with a couple of game changing mods can change the experience to pull you into the game for hours without even playing the actual game all that much.  

 

Cons. 

-mods can be buggy and absolutely destroy performance  

-A.I can be either really OP to sometimes being really stupid. Put an A.I in an AA truck and try to fly an A10 and you'll know. Or for example the way they drive vehicles or fly helis is pretty lack luster, better off playing as the pilot and then switching to the character you want after you land.  

-performance even on low settings is an experience to behold and don’t worry its never your hardware because everyone plays the game at less than 80fps.  

-the game can be a running simulator at times but it really doesn’t bother me since there is plenty of Transportation and you eventually get enough patience to not mind. 

-multiplayer is pretty dead sadly I would love to play a modded server with people but don’t have many options since every server has more than 90 ping and less than 500 most of the time.  

 

MODS 

This is going the be the best modded experience you'll ever see in a game, it's what makes this game so enjoyable and still has consistent mods coming out. Wanna fly an arc 170 from Star Wars and do strafing runs on covenant soldiers while an iraqi city is being pounded by American bombs? Well you can quite literally do that.  some of the CUP mods make the game much better and give the base game a lot more content. ACE on the other hand makes the game much more realistic in the sense of health and ballistics. A true military experience this game is, just get it.
i love it bc it has so much open world
